fixed.member: og ui sheet components, screens and world
fixed.summary: The screens sheet draws pagination's, the calendar's and the tree's chevrons instead of warning on every cell; the components sheet's HUD page stacks into a scrolling column on a phone instead of laying the minimap over the vitals; the world sheet frames its scene for a portrait phone, so its units and their tags stay on the screen; StatusGrid's overflow fixture no longer has more time left than its duration.
